sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 13754 of 2023

Applicant :- Lalman
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru.
The Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Santosh Kumar Srivastava
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2.

The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in Fir No.259 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B Ipc
and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Kotwali Akbarpur, District Ambedkar Nagar.

3.  In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married to the applicant on 08.02.2023 and subsequently on 15.05.2023, she was hanged to death by the matrimonial family.
The charge-sheet was filed against the applicant.
The cause of death as per the postmortem report is shown as asphyxia due to ante mortem hanging and apart from the ligature mark, no other Lalman vs State Of U.P. Thru.

4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the the fact that there was no material on record to suggest that the victim was harassed mentally or physically soon before death in relation to the demand of dowry at the instance of the applicant coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is in custody since 23.05.2023, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Lalman be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 13.2.2024 akverma  Lalman vs State Of U.P. Thru. The Prin. Secy. Home ... on 13 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160328701/
